title: scene spec: clarify region destroy eject and update echo
description: Two draft-atwood-jmap-scene-00 ambiguities found implementing JMAP-38uq.3: (1) L1117 says destroy 'removes ... all contained SceneObject and SceneAvatar records' and also 'Active avatars are ejected (their leftAt is set)'; setting leftAt on a record that is then destroyed is unobservable over JMAP. Implementation destroys the avatars (SceneAvatar/changes reports them destroyed). (2) L1104 example shows updated: {id: null}, but RFC 8620 §5.3 echoes server-changed properties; the implementation echoes {updatedAt}. Spec should state the intended behaviour.
notes:
Mark 2026-10-20: Scene specs have known bugs; no further Scene crate work until the spec is fixed.
Mark 2026-10-20: Scene/VTC specs fixed (jmap-chat-spec 63e9d08); work resumed. Re-check scope against new spec before implementing.
